services_heading: Complete Grass Cutting and Lawn Care Across Newcastle

services.title: Weekly Grass Cutting
services.desc: Regular fortnightly or weekly cuts tailored to your garden's growth and season. Consistent height, neat edges, and reliable scheduling.

services.title: One-Off Garden Cuts
services.desc: Overgrown lawn? We'll handle it fast — from light tidy-ups to heavy clearance. Same or next-day service available.

services.title: Lawn Edge Trimming
services.desc: Crisp borders along patios, beds, and pathways. Keeps your garden looking well-maintained and adds definition to every space.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Tackle overgrown plots and neglected gardens. We remove cuttings and tidy the whole space, leaving you with a blank canvas.

services.title: Commercial Grass Cutting
services.desc: Regular maintenance for business properties, carparks, and open grounds across Newcastle. Professional, reliable, on-schedule service.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Tidy
services.desc: Spring clean-ups, autumn leaf clearance, and winter garden prep. Keep your outdoor space ready for every season.

about_pullquote: A tidy garden is the sign of someone who cares. That's how we work.
about_para_1: We've been cutting grass and maintaining gardens across Newcastle for over twelve years. Started as a one-man operation in Shieldfield, we've grown into a trusted local business serving homes and small commercial properties right across the city. Every job, big or small, gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Customers come back because we show up on time, do the job properly, and treat your garden with respect. We're not interested in rushing through three cuts a day — we focus on getting it right and building relationships with people who want a gardener they can rely on.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Been using them for two years now, never missed a week. Garden always looks pristine. Fair pricing and they're genuinely friendly blokes. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called them about an overgrown mess after six months away. They cleared it all the same week and quoted me for regular cuts. Brilliant service, proper job done.
reviews.author: Lisa M.

reviews.text: Used them for the business property. Turned up every fortnight without fail, and the garden looks immaculate. Reliable and professional — exactly what we needed.
reviews.author: David C.
